title: McGraw Hill Announces Participation in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: McGraw Hill, Inc. (NYSE: MH; “McGraw Hill” and the “Company”), a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, today announced that it will participate in the following conferences: Morgan Stanley Business Services One-on-One Day : May 11, 2026 – The Company’s Investor Relations team will participate in investor meetings. 21st Annual Needham Technology, Media, Consumer Conference : May 14, 2026 – Philip Moyer, McGraw Hill’s President and CEO, will participate in a fireside chat. The presentation is scheduled for 12:45 pm ET. J.P. Morgan 2026 Global Technology, Media, and Communications Conference : May 18, 2026, Boston, MA – Philip Moyer, McGraw Hill’s President and CEO, will participate in a fireside chat and in investor meetings. The presentation is scheduled for 9:05 am ET. The presentations will be webcast, with access instructions available on https://investors.mheducation.com/overview/default.aspx . The webcasts
